Feel like you should be further along by now? Further along than what? Personal failures are measured against a standard that most of us never choose. Drew and I unpack this through the story of a prince raised never to experience failure, and the surprising origin of the word "sin.” We look at how a ruined experiment led to the discovery of penicillin, why a monk confessed to his mistakes for hours at a time, and how a woman's belief that she needed a million dollars a year to start a family fell apart under a few honest questions.
